name: What safety measures are implemented during commercial painting projects?
description: Safety measures include proper equipment use, PPE for painters, cordoning off work areas, ensuring ventilation, and adhering to OSHA standards.

mainEntity.name: What safety measures are implemented during commercial painting projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount on commercial painting projects. Contractors implement various measures, including proper use of ladders, scaffolding, and lifts, ensuring all equipment is regularly inspected and maintained. Painters wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) such as respirators, safety glasses, and gloves to protect against paint fumes and splashes. Work areas are typically cordoned off to prevent unauthorized access, and proper ventilation is ensured, especially when using low-VOC or specialized coatings. Adherence to OSHA standards is a core practice.
